system.description:
The dead fear the puissant necromancers of the Giovanni for good reason: with Torment you lash the shades themselves with searing energies, punishing them for their defiance.

Though you remain in the physical world, you may make Physical Challenges against wraiths, retesting with Occult, often directing the blow with a physical strike. Your attacks inflict lethal damage on the wraith. A wraith discorporated by this power is banished to the deeper levels of the Underworld for a full month, unable to return.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
